Container.Name: Inkpact
Container.Overview:
Inkpact is a self-hosted notes app with real-time collaborative editing: notebooks and notes in a tree, a block editor that syncs live between your devices, attachments, search, tags, favorites, links between notes with backlinks, version history with restore, offline use as an installed app, an import from Joplin and an export of everything to Markdown. AGPL-3.0, no paid features.
It needs a PostgreSQL 18 server: add the official PostgreSQL container from Community Apps first (see Requires).
Container.Requires: Before the first start, two things, once: 1. A PostgreSQL 18 server with a user and a database for Inkpact. With the official PostgreSQL container, in its console (psql -U postgres): CREATE ROLE inkpact LOGIN PASSWORD 'a long password'; CREATE DATABASE inkpact OWNER inkpact; 2. The data folder, writable by the user Inkpact runs as, in the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/inkpact && chown -R 1654:1654 /mnt/user/appdata/inkpact The full guide: https://github.com/GotGeeks/Inkpact/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md#unraid

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The host port for Inkpact's web interface. Behind a reverse proxy (Traefik, Nginx Proxy Manager), point it here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Attachments, the keys that keep you signed in, and the database dump written before each update that changes the database. Must belong to UID 1654 (see Requires). Back it up together with the database.

Config.Name: Database connection
Config.Description: Where PostgreSQL 18 is, and the user and database you made for Inkpact. Host is the Unraid server's address (not localhost), or the PostgreSQL container's name when both are on the same custom Docker network. A password with a ; in it does not fit here: choose another.

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: A code of your choice that lets the first visitor create the administrator account. Open the web UI and enter it. Once the account exists the code does nothing; you can then clear this field.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: Only for a reverse proxy outside the private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16): its address. Docker and Unraid are covered already.

Config.Name: Proxies in front
Config.Description: With two proxies in front of Inkpact (a Cloudflare or Tailscale tunnel in front of Traefik), set 2, so that the login limit counts each visitor and not the outer proxy.

Config.Name: Largest file
Config.Description: The largest file that can be added to a page, in bytes (52428800 is 50 MB).

Config.Name: Update check
Config.Description: Once a day Inkpact asks GitHub for its newest release, to tell the administrator about an update (nothing about your install is sent). false stops it. Updating itself is Unraid's Check for updates.

Config.Name: Log format
Config.Description: simple: one readable line per entry, as Unraid's log viewer shows it. json: one JSON object per entry, for a log collector (Loki, Graylog).
